content.short: Ankr is a decentralized Web3 infrastructure provider offering globally distributed node networks, RPC services, and liquid staking solutions.
content.description: Ankr is a leading Web3 infrastructure provider that enables developers to build and scale decentralized applications with ease. By providing high-performance RPC endpoints and a globally distributed network of nodes, Ankr ensures reliable and low-latency access to the Mantle Network for dApps and wallets. Additionally, Ankr's liquid staking products allow users to earn rewards on their assets while maintaining liquidity, further strengthening the DeFi landscape within the Mantle ecosystem.
content.meta: Ankr provides high-performance RPC infrastructure and liquid staking solutions for Mantle. Discover Ankr on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
